summary: Phase F (simplified login) and Phase G (AI pre-qualification exam) FRONTEND flows fully verified end-to-end via Playwright. All 5 scenarios from the review request PASS. (1) Phase F login: admin seffabdallah7@gmail.com + Admin@2026! + captcha through auth-submit-btn redirects DIRECTLY to /admin; otp-input never renders. (2) Session persistence: hard reload on /admin keeps the user logged in (POST /auth/refresh is called on load and re-issues token). (3) Phase G candidate: fresh candidate registered (captcha only, immediate token), applied to a job on JobDetail (CV file upload via set_input_files on the hidden cv-input, cover-note-input filled, submit-application-btn -> apply-success). On 'Mes postulations' the screening quiz auto-opens (data-testid screening-quiz) with 4 AI-generated questions; screening-answer-0..3 filled, screening-submit-btn -> screening-done shown; after closing, the card displays screening-completed-<appId>. (4) Phase G admin: after re-login as admin, in Candidatures the corresponding app-row-<id> was clicked and 'Voir l'examen IA' (view-exam-btn) opened the dialog which correctly renders exam-verdict ('Verdict : A verifier'), exam-score ('10/100'), exam-analysis (full Claude analysis text) and exam-qa-0..3 with each question + its answer. (5) Confidentiality: candidate-side GET /api/applications/me returns screening with only ['questions','answers','completed','completed_at'] — NO ai_* fields; and no exam-verdict/exam-score/exam-analysis test-ids render on the candidate dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.js is 1283 lines — should still be split into feature-scoped modules (Applications table + detail dialog + exam dialog + schedule dialog) for maintainability.
CandidateDashboard.js exceeds 500 lines and mixes 5 sub-components — consider splitting Applications / InterviewsView / ContractsView / ProfileForm into separate files.

The auto-open effect in Applications (autoRef.current) only picks the first pending screening once per mount; if the candidate has multiple pending screenings and dismisses the first without answering, the second won't auto-open until reload. Consider iterating on pending screenings sequentially after onDone.

Auth.js still contains the legacy 'step === otp' branch (verifyOtp + otp-input UI) even though the login flow now returns {token,user} directly and never sets step to 'otp'. Dead code — safe to remove to keep the file clean and avoid confusion for future testers/devs.

Login/register error handling calls refreshCaptcha() on failure — good. But the captcha ID is single-use server-side; if refresh fails silently (empty catch), user is stuck with the old captcha_id. Consider surfacing a toast on refresh failure.
